skill.summary: Helps users choose charts and improve visual data communication.
skill.author: shubhamsaboo

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, network activity, filesystem access, or executable behavior. No remediation is required.

content.user_title: Choose Better Charts for Data Stories
content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong chart can hide or distort important data patterns. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code select chart types, improve dashboards, and explain visualization choices.
actual_capabilities: Recommends chart types for comparison, distribution, relationship, composition, and time trends.
Explains chart choices with rationale and interpretation guidance.
Reviews visualizations for clarity, truthful scales, simplicity, and accessibility.
Guides dashboard design for presenting data insights.
Suggests implementation examples using tools such as matplotlib and Plotly.
limitations: Does not include executable code, scripts, or bundled visualization libraries.
Requires the user to provide data context, goals, and audience details.
Cannot verify chart accuracy without source data.
Does not replace domain expertise for regulated reporting decisions.

use_cases.title: Select a Chart Type
use_cases.description: Turn a data question into a suitable chart with a clear rationale and presentation goal.

use_cases.title: Improve a Dashboard
use_cases.description: Review dashboard layouts for clarity, accessibility, and focused decision support.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual Reports
use_cases.description: Shape charts and interpretation notes for reports, slides, or stakeholder updates.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Chart Recommendation
prompt_templates.prompt: I have data about [variables] and want to show [message]. Recommend the best chart type and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Existing Chart
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this chart description: [chart details]. Suggest changes for clarity, honest scaling, labels, and accessibility.

prompt_templates.title: Dashboard Design Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dashboard for [audience] tracking [metrics]. Recommend chart types, layout priorities, and interpretation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Visualization Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare visualization options for [complex dataset]. Address tradeoffs, misleading patterns to avoid, accessibility, and implementation options.

output_examples.input: Show monthly revenue over two years and highlight seasonal changes.
output: Use a line chart with one point per month.
Annotate recurring peaks and dips to show seasonality.
Keep the y-axis baseline honest unless a clear note explains otherwise.

output_examples.input: Compare satisfaction scores across five product segments.
output: Use a sorted bar chart for clear segment comparison.
Add confidence intervals if survey sample sizes vary.
Avoid a pie chart because small score differences are hard to compare.

best_practices: Start with the user question before choosing a chart.
Use honest scales, direct labels, and accessible color contrast.
Include interpretation guidance that explains what the viewer should notice.
anti_patterns: Do not use pie charts for many categories or small differences.
Do not truncate axes in ways that exaggerate differences.
Do not add decorative elements that hide the data signal.

faq.question: Can this skill create chart code?
faq.answer: It can suggest code examples, but it does not include executable code or libraries.

faq.question: Which chart types does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers comparison, distribution, relationship, composition, and time trend charts.

faq.question: Can it review existing visualizations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess clarity, scales, labels, simplicity, and accessibility.

faq.question: Does it work for dashboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend dashboard chart choices, layout priorities, and interpretation notes.

faq.question: Does it need my data file?
faq.answer: No. It can advise from a description, but more context improves recommendations.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to install?
faq.answer: The reviewed skill is prompt-only and contains no executable code.
